human_review_text: The paper addresses the issue of heterogeneity in the multi-label learning process. It transforms multi-label tasks into multi-task learning and innovatively incorporates the MoE model into visual classification tasks. Drawing inspiration from models like MMoE and PLE, the authors employed multiple experts and gating theories to learn various labels in their experiments. To prevent negative transfer during the model learning process, they also employed a shared expert approach to learn label correlations. Finally, the authors conducted experiments on the VOC and MS-COCO datasets and achieved outstanding performance.
